group_1.textLeft: Why do you work for Shii, anyway?

group_1.textRight: And I know that Magical Girls...
like getting rid of bad guys that cause problems@for everyone?
Shii said that Magical Girls are pitiful people@who got tricked into making wishes.
Which one of those is true?@What do you think, Nagisa?

group_1.textLeft: I feel like...it's a case-by-case thing.
I'm gonna become the kind of Magical Girl@that I want to be.

group_1.textRight: That's also why I'm working on becoming@a Magical Girl who does good.
I don't really know what to do about@the unfortunate ones.

group_1.textLeft: You don't have to do good as a Magical Girl, though.
Unless someone's paying you,
it's not like you've gotta keep doing this.
...What did you wish for when you became@a Magical Girl?

group_1.textRight: What was it? ...Oh, what was it?@What a pain; what was it?
What a pain, what a pain...
What did you wish for, Nagisa?

group_1.textLeft: ...@[chara:200701:lipSynch_0][wait:0.8][chara:200701:lipSynch_1]I don't remember.

group_1.textRight: That means you're just like me!

group_1.textLeft: ...Do you think you're doing good things...
...to make up for something that was important@to you?

group_1.textRight: ...Maybe? I might be?@What about you, Nagisa?

group_1.textLeft: We're not talking about me.

group_1.textRight: I must've lost something very precious to me@a long, long time ago, probably?
Or maybe there was something you ruined?

group_1.textLeft: I don't...really care what it is that I forgot.
I don't need to recall every little detail about stuff.

group_1.textRight: You mean you can't remember, either?@[chara:390101:lipSynch_0][wait:0.8][chara:390101:lipSynch_1][chara:390101:cheek_0][chara:390101:face_mtn_ex_014.exp3.json][chara:390101:motion_100]Just like me again!

group_1.textLeft: Yuu, what did...@Scratch that.
What kinds of feelings...
...were attached to that important thing you forgot?

group_1.textRight: What a pain, what a pain.

group_1.narration: The two who jumped from the cliff@over the sea never resurfaced.@The End.

group_1.textLeft: You can't get back what you've lost.
Doesn't matter how much guilt or regret@you feel about it.
(...It's just gone for good.)
If it's not coming back to you,
maybe it's better if it never does.

group_1.textRight: Whatever I forgot must've meant the world to me.
And yet I still haven't picked it back up.

group_1.narration: The girl who had lost everything@made one final wish:@To lose her sanity to the point@where she could no longer remember herself.@The End.

group_1.textCenter: (Magic power is fueled by emotional energy.)
(And while Yuu does have emotions, they're not@coherent or consistent at all.)
(That's why I mistook her magic for a Witch's@at first.)
(There's an unnatural lack of any sort of negative@feelings in her.)
(The emotions she does have are absolutely@refusing to connect to the future.)
(That's why her perspective and any conversations@with her just go around in circles.)

group_1.textLeft: Doing good deeds without a purpose@won't get you anywhere.
You're just circling a huge void over and over again.
What kind of future do you wanna go to@to make up for what you lost?
The actions we choose to take have gotta lead@to a future.
From the best of us to the worst,
there's no bell that rings and no curtains that close@to say that the show's over.
Just being alive carries us forward into the future.
Even with your job where you're following a list,
it's at least gonna have to end if you wipe out@all of humanity.
The way you're going, there aren't gonna be@any more lists in your future.

group_1.textRight: My future...is just gonna be me? Alone?

group_1.textLeft: All those good deeds you're doing—
Where are they supposed to take you?

group_1.textRight: I can't go past "The End" because it'd leave me@all by myself.

group_1.textLeft: As long as we stay the way we are,
there'll be no such thing as a beautiful ending.
You're Yuu.

group_1.textRight: Yuu can't move forward to tomorrow?
Or even go anywhere at all, you know?

group_1.textLeft: Mmph! I sense a Witch!
And if there's a Witch, that means we've gotta@defeat it!
We're Magical Girls, after all!
[chara:200701:effect_emotion_angry_0][se:7219_strain]Nagisa's putting her back into showing off here.
What the heck are you standing around@daydreaming about?!
...Your name is Yuu. You're a Magical Girl who does@good things.
Now wakey-wakey and come help me@beat this Witch!
Just follow me!
